label: the copula with tum: ho
note: ho is introduced by HI-C85-tum-ho, which completes the copula set (hun, ho, hain, hai) for the first time. The note's complaint was precise -- ho occurred inside the age frame as a lump and no atom introduced it independently -- so the lesson gives it on its own and then shows the level matching end to end, where tum takes ho and bolo while aap takes hain and boliye.
